question: Can the already-safe CB11 output absorb the AO6-relative zero-luminance chroma residual under one analytical maximum step and recover AO6 preference without new boundaries?

operator.safe_base: unchanged CB11 characteristic luminance plus source chroma
operator.residual: zero-luminance AO6 chroma minus zero-luminance CB11 chroma
operator.scale: one maximum analytical alpha in [0,1] from the CB11 base preserving cube and source-relative epsilon boundaries
operator.forbidden: fit, learned selector, per-image strength, hard clipping, Lab compression, spatial mask or post-score rescue

stop_rules: Any automatic failure closes the exact safe-base residual before visual preference and without rescue.
Preference failure closes the exact residual without strength, population, round or gate changes.
Pass opens only a wholly new source confirmation; this consumed development population cannot promote a product or stock claim.
claim_ceiling: Development-only explicit safe-base chroma-residual evidence on previously consumed CC0 display proxies; not fresh confirmation, stock response, calibration, population preference or product promotion.
